summary: Data centers are prohibited citywide unless explicitly approved as part of a Planned Area Development district.
text: Data Centers are not permitted to operate in the City of Chandler unless explicitly approved as part of a Planned Area Development zoning district.

source.citation: City of Chandler Ordinance No. 5033, signed PDF

confidence_note: Effective date is carried from City and trade reporting; it does not appear in the ordinance text obtained.
